problem.title: Having ChatGPT isn't the same as having integrated AI.
problem.level1Desc: The user asks questions to an AI. This is the basic level most organizations know today.
problem.level2Desc: The AI begins communicating with the organization's tools and data. Responses become contextualized and relevant.
problem.level3Desc: AI agents execute tasks and complete workflows with human supervision. AI becomes an active team member.
problem.highlight: RAPIA guides organizations toward levels 2 and 3.

act2.sub2: The same tasks, every day. They don't move the business forward, but no one else will do them.

act3.ariaLabel: The proposal: an AI that takes the load
act3.line1: What if you didn't have to carry it all alone?
act3.line2b: A system that does the work.
act3.sub: AI isn't here to take your place. It's here to take your load.

act4.ariaLabel: The handoff: you decide, the system executes
